name: deployment
patch:
# kubectl -n shop patch deployment api --patch-file api.patch.yaml
# Sets requests only; limits stay as they are. Applying it restarts the pods.
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 120m
            memory: 1536Mi

name: statefulset rounds memory up to Mi
patch:
# kubectl -n shop patch statefulset db --patch-file db.patch.yaml
# Sets requests only; limits stay as they are. Applying it restarts the pods.
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: 301Mi

name: daemonset
patch:
# kubectl -n shop patch daemonset agent --patch-file agent.patch.yaml
# Sets requests only; limits stay as they are. Applying it restarts the pods.
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 120m
            memory: 1536Mi

name: cronjob
patch:
# kubectl -n shop patch cronjob nightly --patch-file nightly.patch.yaml
# Sets requests only; limits stay as they are. Takes effect from the next run.
spec:
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: api
            resources:
              requests:
                cpu: 120m
                memory: 1536Mi

name: raised cpu limit
patch:
# kubectl -n shop patch deployment api --patch-file api.patch.yaml
# Sets requests, and raises a limit to its new request where it would be exceeded. Applying it restarts the pods.
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 120m
            memory: 1536Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 120m

name: raised both limits
patch:
# kubectl -n shop patch deployment api --patch-file api.patch.yaml
# Sets requests, and raises a limit to its new request where it would be exceeded. Applying it restarts the pods.
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 120m
            memory: 1536Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 120m
            memory: 1536Mi

name: limit not exceeded
patch:
# kubectl -n shop patch deployment api --patch-file api.patch.yaml
# Sets requests only; limits stay as they are. Applying it restarts the pods.
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 120m
            memory: 1536Mi

name: sidecar is an init container
patch:
# kubectl -n shop patch deployment api --patch-file api.patch.yaml
# Sets requests only; limits stay as they are. Applying it restarts the pods.
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      initContainers:
      - name: mesh
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 120m
            memory: 1536Mi
